transform_definitions.extract_internal_asymkv_reducer: Copy only reduce_groups_asymkv unchanged to satisfy the delayed import in preserved HybridKVCache; omit Hybrid-AsymKV generation and probe code.
transform_definitions.retain_selected_qwen_dispatch: Keep selected method branch bodies unchanged after import renaming. Remove unselected dispatcher branches and their unreachable headsplit token-mask setup. Keep generation prepare wrapper with only its unreachable mask-setting if removed.

Add two function-local imports of the corresponding artifact-derived implementations and an explicit unsupported-method exception. Existing Qwen function AST is unchanged.

rename_decouplekv_brand.scope: Owned Python code text, including identifiers, environment names, method strings, docstrings and comments. Five module filenames follow the same lowercase rule. Historical source paths and entrypoint references are protected. RandomDecoupledKV and ordinary decoupled are preserved.
rename_decouplekv_brand.reversibility: Each changed file records exact target character spans and original/replacement fragments. Reverse these spans to recover the previous integration bytes and SHA-256; replay ordered rules to recover current bytes. A global inverse replacement is intentionally not used.
rename_decouplekv_brand.algorithm_verification: Apply identical ordered rules to the original source text before existing import/kernel/resource normalization and compare complete or selected ASTs. Original pre-branding source AST fingerprints are retained; derived renamed_source_* fingerprints are added.

transform_definitions.llava_port_names_imports_and_aliases: See scripts/check_llava_sources.py: deterministic naming/import/kernel/legacy alias normalization; reverse exact edits to prove original SHA and replay the transform to prove target bytes. No arithmetic change in ported modules.

validation_plan.mechanical_copy: Apply declared import/kernel/resource-location changes to source and compare full ast.dump(include_attributes=False) with target.
validation_plan.selected_functions: Find each selected function by name in source and target; require identical function AST hashes, including decorators and default arguments.
validation_plan.selected_dispatcher: Compare every retained method branch body AST after package import normalization; compare prepare_inputs_for_generation_qwen AST after removing exactly the recorded unreachable token-mask if. Assert removed methods have no dispatcher branch.
validation_plan.resources: Require source and target SHA-256 equality.
validation_plan.llava_dispatcher: Compare all four retained branch bodies with opensource replace_llava_onevision. Remove only two leading imports and final fallback else, then compare the whole function AST. Require unchanged Qwen function AST.
validation_plan.branding: Reverse span edits and verify previous target SHA, replay exact ordered naming rules, verify old source AST against recovered integration AST and branded original source AST against new target AST. No AST normalization removes arithmetic, branching, function arguments or non-brand string values.

        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2DecoderLayer.forward = decoder_qwen2_forward_lookm # past vision mask
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Attention.forward = qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_LookM # past vision mask & actual pruning

    elif method == "madakv":
        print("Using MadaKV in LlavaOneVison!")
        transformers.models.llava_onevision.modeling_llava_onevision.LlavaOnevisionModel.forward = LlavaOnevisionModel.forward # is_vision_token_mask past

        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Attention.forward = qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_MadaKV # past vision mask & next-layer budget with updating
    else:
        raise NotImplementedError(f"Unsupported LlavaOnevision method: {method}")

qwen2_model imports modeling_qwen2, which imports hybridkv_cpu and its CUDA extension at module import time. All four patched Llava baselines therefore require kvrepack_kernel even when a given baseline does not call a custom kernel.
